definition.name: Physical context deallocation and combined-profile controls

steps.name: Exercise isolated allocator and authenticated combined profile
steps.run:
set -o pipefail
cargo test --locked -p latent-wasmtime --lib \
  --features development-stack-custody-witness,development-rust-http-combined \
  native_stacks::tests:: -- --test-threads=1 --show-output 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/native-stack-custody.log"
grep -F 'test native_stacks::tests::stack_custody_allocation::original_metadata_charge_survives_actual_stack_context_backing_deallocation ... ok' "$RUNNER_TEMP/native-stack-custody.log"
grep -F 'test native_stacks::tests::combined::combined_workers_require_matching_immutable_proof_before_reservation ... ok' "$RUNNER_TEMP/native-stack-custody.log"

reviewReason: Run the default-off original-context allocator witness in isolation from the Go allocator and compile the authenticated combined-profile tests; do not select any guest profile or alter resource grants.
